baseline.comparison: d9c5945 production-frozen commit versus current worktree

findings.title: Analysis claims are now bound to approved or bounded-selected source snapshots
findings.prior_failure: The old builder recomputed self-consistent result analyses without requiring the source/comparison to exist in the returned ResourceSnapshot.
current_evidence: reporting.py:415-464 rejects unapproved analysis sources, missing or duplicate snapshots, identity mismatches, missing comparisons, duplicate comparisons, and comparison payload mismatches.
reporting.py:467-489 admits an additional source only when it is recorded in a bounded investigation selection; an existing selected key with a different adapter/resource is blocked.

checks.name: foreign_analysis_source
checks.observed: blocked with analysis_source_not_approved; only the approved sales claim remained

checks.name: contradictory_snapshot_comparison
checks.observed: blocked with analysis_snapshot_comparison_mismatch and no numeric claim

checks.name: bounded_expanded_source
checks.observed: a source recorded in InvestigationTrace.selected was accepted as a valid bounded addition and produced a complete report

findings.title: Requiredness is now derived from the approved source contract
findings.prior_failure: A returned AnalysisReport could set required=false and downgrade an incomplete required comparison to a warning/partial report.
current_evidence: reporting.py:398-412 derives requiredness from the approved SourceRef and comparison identity rather than trusting the returned required flag.

checks.name: required_flag_downgrade
checks.observed: with a matching partial source snapshot, an analysis mutated to required=false still returned blocked with required_analysis_insufficient_data

findings.title: Actionable routes are now required and duplicate selections are blocked
findings.prior_failure: A notify result on a card with no configured route could be reported complete; duplicate route selections were also accepted.
current_evidence: reporting.py:333-365 rejects duplicate selections and result/configured-outcome mismatches.
reporting.py:380-388 adds route_not_configured for notify or escalate without an approved route.
reporting.py:645-651 derives blocked status from blockers.

checks.name: foreign_route_and_changed_endpoint
checks.observed: focused reporting tests pass and retain unauthorized_route/route_endpoint_mismatch blockers

findings.title: Renderer retains exact intended route audit records
findings.prior_failure: The simplified renderer exposed only a combined audience/destination line and omitted route key and not-sent reason.
current_evidence: Current rendered appendix includes 'Intended routes not delivered' with route key, destination, label, and caller-owned delivery reason.
reporting.py:698-708 still provides compact front-matter audience context; the detailed route record is retained in the appendix.

checks.name: renderer_route_audit
checks.observed: rendered report contains `owner`, slack://owner|weekly, and 'Caller owns delivery; not sent.'

findings.title: Legacy receipt replay no longer fabricates a historical report
current_evidence: mcp_server.py:522-533 now copies an archived report only when the receipt result contains one; otherwise it returns the original result unchanged and adds report_unavailable_reason.
The no-archived-report branch does not call the report builder or fetch current resources, so an older receipt cannot acquire a present-day status, coverage view, or fabricated report.

checks.name: new_receipt_replay
checks.observed: 22 MCP/local replay tests pass; current receipts replay the embedded report without refetching or rebuilding

checks.name: older_receipt_no_fabricated_report
checks.observed: 1 passed; the builder was monkeypatched to fail, replay returned the original result unchanged, added report_unavailable_reason, and made no source or judger calls

checks.name: checkpoint_hash_probe
checks.observed: 1 passed; the offline fake-provider probe now records the approved-card hash at the checkpoint before hashing

evidence: WatchResult probability is rendered as P(present), including absent judgments.
QuestionResult probability is rendered as P(supported), not as probability of a yes answer or generic confidence.
